name: Alchemy

overview.lead: Alchemists brew elixirs, potions and flasks, and in Forever they also make the dyes other crafters need. The classic healing potions are now First Aid crafts.

points.text: Raiders will want flasks and the new 30-minute elixirs. Herbalism supplies the herbs, and engineers use alchemy materials too.
Profession details on this page come from Blizzard posts, the beta and Forever guides.

101.summary: What Alchemy makes in Forever, how to train it and how to level it.

steps.text: Open the professions window with K, then search or filter the recipe list and track a recipe in the objectives frame.
Leave healing potions to First Aid: Superior and Major Healing Potions moved there.
Gather Frilled Lichen, Rosecap and Stranglevine for the Cerulean, Magenta and Viridian Dye other crafts now need.
Place a Mana Well at skill 20, a Fermenter at 140 and an Alchemy Laboratory at 300.

mistakes.mistake: Training Alchemy to make healing potions.
mistakes.fix: Superior and Major Healing Potions are First Aid crafts in Forever; the old Alchemy recipes are gone.

mistakes.mistake: Stacking the Mana Well buff with Blessing of Wisdom.
mistakes.fix: The Mana Well buff matches Blessing of Wisdom and does not stack with it.

steps.text: Train Journeyman at skill 50 and level 10, Expert at skill 125 and level 20, and Artisan at skill 200 and level 35. 300 is the cap.
For Artisan Alchemy, Alliance players train at Feathermoon Stronghold (Feralas) or the Emerald Sanctuary (Felwood).
Reaching 150, 225 and 300 for the first time in a craft each earns 1 Legacy point.
Build Merchant's Favor by filling Waylaid Crates and handing the sealed crates to Marcy Baker at Three Corners in western Redridge.

mistakes.mistake: Waiting at the Journeyman cap of 150 before training Expert.
mistakes.fix: Expert needs skill 125 and level 20, so train it between 125 and 150.

201.summary: What raiders need from an Alchemist, and the Auction House lines to watch.

steps.text: Make flasks at an Alchemy Lab. The Alchemy Laboratory camp object (Alchemy 300) means no trip to Scholomance.
Brew the 30-minute Favor elixirs for raiders: Grizzly, Owl, Cunning, Greater Cleric's, Greater Mageblood and Phalanx.
Elixir of the Grizzly needs Alchemy 300, Honored and 240 Favor.
Offer Rage potions to Druids as well as Warriors.

mistakes.mistake: Planning a trip to Scholomance to make flasks.
mistakes.fix: The placeable Alchemy Laboratory camp object (Alchemy 300) removes the need.

mistakes.mistake: Telling a Druid that Rage potions are for Warriors only.
mistakes.fix: Rage, Great Rage and Mighty Rage Potions now work for Druids as well as Warriors.

steps.text: Dyes are a new input for other crafts, and raiders use elixirs and flasks, so those are the lines to watch on the Auction House. Trading is subject to Blizzard policy.

mistakes.mistake: Assuming a Runecloth Bag needs only cloth.
mistakes.fix: It now takes 4 Magenta and 2 Cerulean Dye, which Alchemists make.
